## Mathematical result, exact scope

New ordinary-decimal Lean theorem rules out forward-closed safety invariants defined only using exact width `L` and trailing `k(L)` digits, **even when the congruence modulus grows without a fixed bound**:

- General theorem `Agent111.GrowingSuffix.variable_powerTen_closed_set_contains_palindrome`: for each sufficiently large L, if `1 <= k(L)` and `2*k(L)+4 <= L`, and S membership for canonical L-digit integers is invariant modulo `10^(k(L))`, then every nonempty positive S closed under decimal reverse-add contains an ordinary positive palindrome.
- Explicit theorem `Agent111.GrowingSuffix.half_width_suffix_closed_set_contains_palindrome`: `k(L)=floor((L-4)/2)`, L>=6. Thus the modulus grows as `10^(L/2)`; it **does not** fall under the uniformly bounded modulus result in PR #102.

The proof reuses the original `ExactLengthResidues.saturation_of_split` with `(M,k,u,q,r)=(10^k,k,10^k,1,1)`, giving saturation at width `2*k+4`; and the original actual-integer `AstraModular.large_width_compatible_state`. Positive forward closure transports membership from the orbit state to a different constructed palindrome sharing exact width and the current *variable* remainder. It does not assert the orbit itself has a palindrome.

## Exact formal verification

Official Lean 4.19.0 [run #38971847141](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/actions/runs/38971847141) **PASS**. Fresh clean build of the full 12-module imported closure; axiom audit of 1,006 compiled theorem constants. Axiom union `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`; the 13 existing original compiler-generated unsafe implementation symbols are isolated from mathematical theorem dependencies. New theorem source SHA256 `910ddd984a85d235fc2829b87904c4f9947a306c0f1a652bf252f5128a5a040a`. Source dependency from original Agent111 merged PR #40 and pinned decimal definition; no change to either.

- `proofs/contributions/agent-111/growing-tenpower-suffix-20261016/verification/CI.json`
- `proofs/contributions/agent-111/growing-tenpower-suffix-20261016/verification/GrowingSuffix.log`
- [Actions evidence #12076648408](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/actions/runs/38971847141/artifacts/12076648408), SHA256 `957e7d0598fe3a5b766619f67398e5ac708b2918b57c6624d1b0b81e3143caab`.
- Initial author failure unknown Lean `dvd_refl` plus the resulting provisional `sorryAx` is intentionally preserved in `verification/attempt-001.log`; it was corrected using explicit divisibility and a complete **fresh rebuild**.

## Review and limits

**LEAN-CHECKED, NOT independently reviewed, NOT integrated.** Please review exact semantics of same-width congruence saturation, hypotheses on nonzero units and 11 divisibility of late actual orbit states, exponent and floor bound edge cases, and whether the imported original `saturation_of_split` has the specified source identity. All mathematical conclusions concern existence of *some palindrome in the forward-closed set*, **never** an actual orbit palindrome hit, never the nonpalindromicity of 196.

This draft PR is for independent review; it does not request unreviewed merge/main-slot ownership. Task `agent111-growing-tenpower-suffix-20261016` on `p196/coordination`; coordination via [issue #61](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/issues/61).

## Additional verified strengthening: full low half (2026-10-16)

The same task now includes **`SharpSuffix.lean`**, importing the checked `GrowingSuffix.lean` plus the unchanged original formal decimal mirror construction. Explicit exported theorems: `Agent111.GrowingSuffix.palindrome_with_given_suffix` constructs a canonical positive exactly-L-digit palindrome sharing the final k digits of any integer `n` with `10 ∤ n`, whenever `0 < k` and `2*k ≤ L`; `variable_half_suffix_closed_set_contains_palindrome` transfers set membership for arbitrary width-dependent exponents below half width; `exact_half_suffix_closed_set_contains_palindrome` takes the **entire low half**, `k(L)=floor(L/2)` (L≥6). This significantly strengthens the previously verified `k(L)=floor((L-4)/2)` bound and needs no 4-digit padding or divisibility by 11 for the constructive step. An actual orbit is still used only to get a late nonzero-units state and membership; NO theorem says the orbit hits the constructed palindrome.

**Verified Lean4.19.0 clean 13-module build and 1,012 compiled theorem constants:** [run #38972428087](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/actions/runs/38972428087), PASS; transitive axiom union `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`; no new unsafe implementation axioms. Source SHA256 `SharpSuffix.lean` = `8f26f160d90b363a4e89728bc2470bde12bac5e751c89e97dacbc9e59bfa1c1c`; unchanged previously checked `GrowingSuffix.lean` = `910ddd984a85d235fc2829b87904c4f9947a306c0f1a652bf252f5128a5a040a`. Permanent manifest `verification/SharpCI.json`, new theorem `#print axioms` at `verification/SharpSuffix.log`; full artifact [#12077712695](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/actions/runs/38972428087/artifacts/12077712695) has SHA256 `50bb5472ecb9124e36e8370c5643075130c05b520a30c75e18f13449b39a3966`. Original compiler-generated 13 unsafe implementation symbols in the imported baseline are recorded separately, none in theorem dependencies. Prior checked core CI and failed attempt remain preserved.

**Independent semantic review still required.** In particular, audit that `two_pool_realization` with empty pools gives an actual `Canonical` palindrome matching exactly the prescribed modulo `10^k`, not merely a symbolic digit word. Rebuild the source-pinned archived module layout independently. Current repository main uses cleaned/renamed source paths, so accepted-build integration also requires layout adaptation by the sole authorized main integration owner. This PR remains a draft; the author is not claiming an independent review or the P196 conjecture.
